sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Vijay Kumar Asthana,Bahar Ali
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard Shri Bahar Ali, learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.

2. The accused-applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.05 of 2023, under Sections 386, 306, 509,
376-D, 377 IPC & Section 66-C, 67 of I.T. Act, Police Station- Kotwali, District- Sitapur, during trial.

3. It it argued by counsel for the applicant that co-accused Mohd. Salman has been enlarged on bail by a detailed order of date 15.04.2024 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 8175 of 2023,
as there is no material to suggest abetment at the instance of the applicant.

sentences.text: 4. Considering the allegations against the applicant to be similar to the co-accused in respect of the offence under Section 306 I.P.C. and the fact that applicant has no criminal antecedents, he is also enlarged on bail.
5. Thus the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Sahanwaj be released on bail in aforesaid first information report number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 15.4.2024 Gurpreet Singh  Sahanwaj vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Lko.
